career_ladder.note: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group D) is the single-window recruitment gateway for all Group D posts (Peon, Beldar, Mali, Chowkidar, Field Attendant, Workshop Helper) across Haryana state departments, boards, and corporations. Career advancement is governed by the Haryana Group D Employees Service Rules.

steps.designation: Group D Attendant / Peon / Beldar / Field Worker
steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 01/2023 (Group D Recruitment) & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules

steps.designation: Senior Peon / Jamadar / Daftri / Head Mali
steps.source_label: Haryana Group D Employees Promotion Cadre Rules

steps.designation: Junior Clerk / Store Munshi / Bill Distributor
steps.years: approx. 12-18 yrs (subject to 10+2 qualification & departmental typing test)
steps.source_label: Haryana Subordinate Ministerial Service Rules (20% promotion quota from Group D to Group C)

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Group D posts under HSSC is governed entirely by a single-tier Common Eligibility Test (CET Group D). Unlike Group C, there is no second written test; final appointment and department allocation are directly made from the CET score merit list.

stages.stage_name: Common Eligibility Test (CET Group D Written Examination)
stages.source_label: HSSC Advt 01/2023 CET Group D Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Awareness, General Science, Reasoning, Quantitative Ability, English Language & Hindi Language (75% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.94 deducted if all 5 options left blank
papers.qualifying_threshold: Competitive merit (40% minimum score for reserved categories, 50% for unreserved)

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge of Haryana — History, Geography, Civics, Economy, Culture, Customs & Current Affairs (25% weightage)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.94 deducted if all 5 options left blank
papers.qualifying_threshold: Competitive merit as part of composite 94-mark paper

financial_package.note: Group D personnel in Haryana are placed in Functional Pay Level DL (FPL-DL) under the Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹16,900.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, Notification No. 1/20/2016-5PR(FD)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹16,900 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹9,802), House Rent Allowance (8% to 24% by city tier, ₹1,800 to ₹4,056), and fixed medical allowance (₹1,000), minus standard employee NPS and insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) at prevailing state rates (58% effective 1 Jul 2025)
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or government staff accommodation
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) of ₹1,000 per month / medical reimbursement
Uniform and washing allowance for designated field posts
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Haryana Civil Services Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: HSSC CET Group D is among the highest-volume mass examinations in the country, witnessing over 1.3 million applicants competing for permanent state subordinate positions.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 98 (calculated: registered candidates ÷ appointed vacancies)
years.source_label: HSSC Advt 01/2023 CET Group D Examination: 13,75,151 applicants registered; 8,55,135 appeared across 17 districts on 21-22 Oct 2023; 14,036 vacancies filled.

official_downloads.note: Official notifications, CET Group D syllabus, answer keys, and final allocation lists are hosted on HSSC's recruitment portal.
